title: Vague, unprioritized musing about more monitoring someday
notes: Very short, low-confidence, no clear decision. Tests confidence calibration and restraint, mirroring fx15's brevity. Intentionally has only one plausible gold atom.

turns.text: We should probably have more monitoring on the background jobs at some point, right? Not urgent, just a thought.

Could be useful eventually, but the jobs haven't caused any incidents so far and the current logging has been enough to debug the couple of issues we've had. I wouldn't prioritize building out dedicated monitoring for them right now.

gold_atoms.text: Adding dedicated monitoring for background jobs was raised as a possible future improvement, but not prioritized — current logging has been sufficient for the few issues encountered so far.
